summary: Build supplier screening, ESG evidence, and due diligence controls through practical responsible procurement training. Enrol today.
lede: Digital supplier due diligence and ESG risk monitoring help procurement, category, and compliance professionals identify and manage risks across supplier relationships. Training covers supplier segmentation, human-rights and ESG screening, evidence validation, and risk scoring, then applies these methods to dashboards, alerts, and corrective-action tracking. Participants practise building evidence matrices, responsible sourcing controls, remediation plans, and management reports to support supplier reviews and sourcing decisions.
audienceIntro: Responsible procurement training is designed for professionals who influence supplier selection, supplier performance, risk governance, and sourcing assurance. Each role below applies the subject in a distinct operational context.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of procurement, sourcing, supplier management, compliance, or supply chain operations. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with supplier onboarding, tender evaluation, or vendor performance reviews will help you apply the exercises quickly. Digital dashboard activities use provided templates and datasets, so advanced software experience is not required.
